citations.quote: **Performance status:** ECOG 2, stable compared with prior visits

candidates.description: A scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients and their ability to perform activities of daily living.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the numerical ECOG score reported in the assessment, physical examination, or subjective sections of the clinical note.
candidates.measurement_definition: Standard ECOG performance status where 0 represents fully active, 1 represents restricted in physically strenuous activity, and 2 represents ambulatory and capable of all self-care but unable to carry out any work activities.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The evidence does not specify the exact timepoint of the assessment relative to the start of new therapy for all patients.

citations.quote: Former smoker, 10 pack‑year history, quit 8 years ago

candidates.description: The patient's historical and current usage of tobacco products.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Review the Social History or Assessment sections for mentions of tobacco use, smoking status, or pack-year history.
candidates.measurement_definition: Categorized as 'Never smoker' if the patient denies any history of tobacco use; 'Former smoker' if the patient reports a history of tobacco use but has ceased; 'Current smoker' if the patient is presently using tobacco.
candidates.name: Smoking History
candidates.uncertainty: Some reports provide pack-year quantitative data while others only provide a categorical status.

limitations: The evidence is limited to a small number of patient records.
Smoking history is documented inconsistently, blending categorical status with quantitative pack-years.
summary: The provided clinical evidence identifies functional status (ECOG Performance Status) and tobacco exposure history as measurable baseline clinical variables for patients with EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
